先選類型，再在畫布放置並編輯；可提供新增下一步，自動連線必須符合以上規則且不覆蓋既有出口。

rules.before: for(const row of data.rows){const li=create('li','');if(kind==='saves')li.textContent=`${t('saved')} · ${row.actor?.name||t('unknown')} · ${date(row.at)}${row.reason?' · '+row.reason:''}${row.source?' · '+row.source:''}`;else{known.set(row.id,row);const button=create('button','button ghost',`${number(row)} · ${t(row.status)} · ${date(row.createdAt)}`);button.type='button';button.onclick=()=>void view(row);li.append(button);if(select&&!model.masterScope&&![...select.options].some(o=>o.value===row.id||o.value==='history:'+row.id)){let group=select.querySelector('[data-vd-history]');if(!group){group=document.createElement('optgroup');group.dataset.vdHistory='true';group.label=t('history');select.append(group);}const option=document.createElement('option');option.value='history:'+row.id;option.textContent=`${number(row)} · ${t(row.status)}`;group.append(option);}}rows.append(li);}
